en.s: The Second Battle of St Albans was a battle of the English Wars of the Roses, fought on 17 February 1461, at St Albans. The army of the Yorkist faction under the Earl of Warwick attempted to bar the road to London north of the town. The rival Lancastrian army used a wide outflanking manoeuvre to take Warwick by surprise, cut him off from London, and drive his army from the field. The victors also released the feeble King Henry VI, who had been Warwick's prisoner, from his captivity. However, they ultimately failed to take advantage of their victory.

zh.t: 第二次圣奥尔本斯战役
zh.s: 1461年2月17日，英格兰玫瑰战争期间发生第二次圣奥尔本斯战役。沃里克伯爵率约克派军队，在城镇以北阻挡通往伦敦的道路。兰开斯特派军队大范围迂回包抄，出其不意地切断沃里克与伦敦的联系，并将其部队逐出战场。胜者还释放了被沃里克囚禁、身体虚弱的国王亨利六世，但最终未能充分利用这次胜利。

en.s: The Battle of Hemmingstedt took place on February 17, 1500 south of the village of Hemmingstedt, near the present village of Epenwöhrden, in the western part of present-day Schleswig-Holstein, Germany. It was an attempt by king John of Denmark and his brother Duke Frederick, who were co-dukes of Schleswig and Holstein, to subdue the peasantry of Dithmarschen, who had established a peasants' republic on the coast of the North Sea. John was at the time also king of the Kalmar Union.

zh.s: 1500年2月17日，黑明施泰特战役发生于该村以南、今天德国石勒苏益格—荷尔斯泰因州西部埃彭韦尔登村附近。共同担任石勒苏益格及荷尔斯泰因公爵的丹麦国王约翰与弟弟腓特烈，企图征服在北海沿岸建立农民共和国的迪特马尔申农民。约翰当时也是卡尔马联盟国王。

en.s: Within the Holy Roman Empire, the War of the Katzenelnbogen Succession (German: Katzenelnbogener Erbfolgekrieg; Dutch: Katzenelnbogische Successieoorlog) or the Katzenelnbogen Succession Struggle (German: Katzenelnbogener Erbfolgestreit, Katzenelnbogische Erbfolgestreit; Dutch: Katzenelnbogische Erfopvolgingsstrijd) (1500–1557) was a war of succession about the County of Katzenelnbogen after the death of William II "the Younger", Landgrave of Hesse. In the end, Philip I, Landgrave of Hesse won the conflict.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 卡策内尔恩博根伯国继承战争
zh.s: 神圣罗马帝国内发生的卡策内尔恩博根伯国继承战争（德语：Katzenelnbogener Erbfolgekrieg；荷兰语：Katzenelnbogische Successieoorlog）又称卡策内尔恩博根继承争端（德语：Katzenelnbogener Erbfolgestreit；荷兰语：Katzenelnbogische Erfopvolgingsstrijd），持续于1500年至1557年。威廉二世（“小威廉”）伯爵去世后，各方为卡策内尔恩博根伯国的继承权开战。最终，黑森伯爵菲利普一世赢得了这场冲突。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.t: Habsburg and Ottoman negotiators reach a peace agreement
en.s: On 17 February 1568, Habsburg and Ottoman negotiators reached an agreement to end their war. The Treaty of Adrianople was signed separately on February21. Negotiations took place in the Ottoman Empire, in present-day Turkey.
en.n: This is agreement reached on February17, distinct from treaty signature on February21.

zh.t: 哈布斯堡与奥斯曼代表达成停战协议
zh.s: 1568年2月17日，哈布斯堡与奥斯曼双方代表达成结束战争的协议。《阿德里安堡条约》于2月21日才正式签署。谈判在奥斯曼帝国境内进行，地点位于今土耳其。
zh.n: 此条记录2月17日达成协议，区别于2月21日正式签约。

en.s: The Battle of Puerto Caballos was a military event during the Anglo–Spanish War to capture the Spanish town and port of Puerto Caballos (present day Puerto Cortés, Honduras) on 17 February 1603 by an English fleet under Christopher Newport and Michael Geare along with the help of French pirates. The English were able to achieve victory after a bitter fight. Two Spanish galleons were captured, one of which was subsequently burned. The Anglo-French consortium occupied the area and after two weeks withdrew with captured booty.

zh.s: 1603年2月17日，英西战争期间，克里斯托弗·纽波特和迈克尔·吉尔率英格兰舰队，在法国海盗协助下进攻西班牙的卡瓦略斯港城镇，即今天洪都拉斯科尔特斯港。英军激战后获胜，俘获两艘西班牙盖伦帆船，随后烧毁其中一艘。英法联合队伍占领当地两周后，带着战利品撤离。

en.t: Nurhaci proclaims himself khan of Later Jin
en.s: On 17 February 1616, Nurhaci proclaimed himself khan and established the Jin state, known as Later Jin, at Hetu Ala in present-day China. His son Hong Taiji renamed the state Qing in 1636.

zh.t: 努尔哈赤在赫图阿拉称汗，建立后金
zh.s: 1616年2月17日，努尔哈赤在今中国境内的赫图阿拉称汗，建立金国，史称后金。他的儿子皇太极于1636年将国号改为清。

en.s: The 1674 Ambon earthquake occurred on February 17 between 19:30 and 20:00 local time in the Maluku Islands. The resulting tsunami reached heights of up to 100 metres (330 ft) on Ambon Island killing over 2,000 people. It was the first detailed documentation of a tsunami in Indonesia and the largest ever recorded in the country.
en.n: This entry records the local date, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1674年2月17日19:30至20:00（当地时间），马鲁古群岛发生安汶地震。随后出现的海啸在安汶岛造成最高达100米（330英尺）的海浪，造成2,000多人死亡。这是印度尼西亚有详细记录的首场海啸，也是该国有记录以来规模最大的海啸。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的当地日期。

en.t: Sixteen expedition members lost near the Evangelistas Islets
en.s: On February 17, 1676, sixteen men from Pascual de Iriarte’s expedition party, including his son, were lost near the Evangelistas Islets in present-day Chile. Their small boat was blown away while they attempted to place a Spanish territorial marker.

zh.t: 16名远征队员在埃万赫利斯塔斯群岛附近失踪
zh.s: 1676年2月17日，帕斯夸尔·德·伊里亚特远征分队的16人，包括他的儿子，在今智利埃万赫利斯塔斯群岛附近失踪。他们试图上岸放置西班牙领土标志时，乘坐的小艇被强风吹走。

en.s: The Battle of Vasai or the Battle of Bassein was fought between the Maratha Empire and the Portuguese rulers of Vasai (Portuguese, Baçaim; English, Bassein), a town near Mumbai (Bombay) in the Konkan region of the present-day state of Maharashtra, India. The Marathas were led by Chimaji Appa, a brother of Peshwa Baji Rao I.
en.n: The Battle of Vasai commences as the Marathas move to invade Portuguese-occupied territory.

zh.s: 瓦赛战役又称巴塞因战役，交战双方是马拉塔帝国和葡萄牙统治下的瓦赛（葡萄牙语：Baçaim；英语：Bassein）。瓦赛是印度今马哈拉施特拉邦孔坎地区的一座城镇，靠近孟买。马拉塔军由奇马吉·阿帕率领，他是佩什瓦巴吉·拉奥一世的兄弟。
zh.n: 马拉塔军开始进攻葡萄牙占领区，瓦赛战役由此打响。

en.s: The Battle of Hart’s Mill took place near Hillsborough, North Carolina between Patriot militia under Joseph Graham and Richard Simmons and a combined force of British and Loyalist militia on February 17, 1781 The Patriot forces returned to North Carolina from Virginia for resupplies and made camp in Orange county. Captain Joseph Graham under Brigadier General Andrew Pickens was sent to scout the area for British/Loyalist activity.

zh.s: 1781年2月17日，约瑟夫·格雷厄姆和理查德·西蒙斯率爱国者民兵，与英国正规军及效忠派民兵在北卡罗来纳州希尔斯伯勒附近的哈特磨坊交战。爱国者部队此前从弗吉尼亚返回北卡罗来纳补充物资，并在奥兰治县扎营。安德鲁·皮肯斯准将派约瑟夫·格雷厄姆上尉侦察当地英军及效忠派活动。

en.s: The Battle of Sadras was the first of five largely indecisive naval battles fought between a British fleet (under Vice-Admiral Sir Edward Hughes) and a French fleet (under Admiral Pierre Suffren) off the east coast of India during the Anglo-French War. Fought on 17 February 1782 near present-day Kalpakkam, the battle was tactically indecisive, but the British fleet suffered the most damage.

zh.s: 萨德拉斯海战是英法战争期间印度东海岸附近五场海战中的第一场。这些海战大多没有明显胜负。战斗发生于1782年2月17日，英国舰队由爱德华·休斯爵士中将指挥，法国舰队由皮埃尔·叙弗朗海军上将指挥。战术上双方未分胜负，但英国舰队受损更重。

en.s: The Action of 17 February 1783 was a minor naval engagement fought in between Jamaica & Cuba in the Caribbean sea between a Royal Navy frigate HMS Fox and a Spanish Navy frigate Santa Catalina. By the end of 1782 the Spanish and French had been on the defensive since the Battle of the Saintes, which signaled British domination of the seas in the Caribbean. Soon after the Royal navy were conducting a blockade off Cap Francois and Fort Royal as well as keeping a watch off Havana. At the same time British frigates were intercepting both Spanish and French privateers.

zh.s: 1783年2月17日，英国皇家海军“狐狸”号护卫舰与西班牙海军“圣卡塔利娜”号护卫舰，在加勒比海牙买加与古巴之间发生小规模海战。1782年底，自圣特海战确立英国在加勒比海的海上优势后，西班牙和法国一直处于守势。英国海军随后封锁法兰西角和皇家堡，并监视哈瓦那外海，同时由护卫舰拦截西法私掠船。

en.s: The battle of Khankala happened on 17 February 1807. In this action, the Khankala fortification was taken by storm. Russian forces entered Chechnya from three directions under the command of General of Infantry S. A. Bulgakov. The purpose of the expedition was to establish control over the strategically important Khankala Gorge.

zh.s: 汉卡拉之战发生于1807年2月17日。俄军强攻并夺取汉卡拉要塞。S. A. 布尔加科夫步兵上将率军从三个方向进入车臣。此次远征旨在控制具有重要战略意义的汉卡拉峡谷。

en.s: The Battle of Mormant (17 February 1814) was fought during the War of the Sixth Coalition between an Imperial French army under Emperor Napoleon I and a division of Russians and Austrians under Count Pyotr Petrovich Pahlen. Enveloped by cavalry and infantry, the outnumbered Allied force was nearly destroyed, with only about a third of its soldiers escaping. This battle and the Battle of Montereau the following day marked the start of a French counteroffensive aiming to drive back Karl Philipp, Prince of Schwarzenberg's Allied Army of Bohemia. The town of Mormant is located 50 kilometres (31 mi) southeast of Paris.

zh.s: 1814年2月17日，第六次反法同盟战争期间，拿破仑一世率法国帝国军队，在莫尔芒与彼得·彼得罗维奇·帕伦伯爵指挥的俄奥部队一个师交战。兵力劣势的联军遭骑兵和步兵包围，几乎全军覆没，仅约三分之一士兵逃脱。这场战役与次日蒙特罗战役，标志着法军开始反攻，试图击退施瓦岑贝格亲王卡尔·菲利普指挥的联军波希米亚军团。莫尔芒位于巴黎东南50公里（31英里）。

en.s: The Weenen massacre (Afrikaans: Bloukransmoorde) was the massacre of Voortrekkers, Khoikhoi and Basuto by the Zulu Kingdom on 17 February 1838. The massacres occurred at Doringkop, Bloukrans River, Moordspruit, Rensburgspruit and other sites around the present day town of Weenen in South Africa's KwaZulu-Natal province.

zh.s: 维嫩大屠杀（南非语：Bloukransmoorde）发生于1838年2月17日，祖鲁王国军队屠杀了迁徙布尔人、科伊科伊人和巴苏陀人。屠杀发生在德灵科普、布劳克兰斯河、穆尔德斯普雷特、伦斯堡斯普雷特等地，地点都在南非夸祖鲁-纳塔尔省今维嫩镇周边。

en.s: The Battle of Miani (Sindhi: مياڻي جي جنگ), also known as the Battle of Meeanee, was a battle between a British army under Charles James Napier and the Talpur army of Sindh, composed mainly of Baloch troops under the Talpur Amirs. led by Amir Nasir Khan Talpur. The battle took place on 17 February 1843 at Miani, Sindh, in what is now modern-day Pakistan.

zh.s: 米亚尼之战（信德语：مياڻي جي جنگ），又称米尼之战，于1843年2月17日在米亚尼爆发，地点在今巴基斯坦信德省。交战双方是查尔斯·詹姆斯·内皮尔率领的英军，以及信德塔尔普尔军队；后者主要由俾路支士兵组成，由塔尔普尔诸酋长统率，其中包括纳西尔·汗·塔尔普尔酋长。

en.s: The Anglo—Sindh War was a military campaign by Britain against the Talpur dynasty which resulted in the incorporation of Sindh into British India. The East India Company, supported by the British Army and Royal Navy, oversaw the campaign between February and March of 1843. Two major battles were fought, the Battle of Hyderabad and Battle of Miani.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 英—信德战争是英国对塔尔普尔王朝发动的一场军事行动，结果信德并入英属印度。东印度公司在英国陆军和皇家海军支持下，于1843年2月至3月负责这场战事。双方进行了两场主要战役：海得拉巴战役和米亚尼之战。

en.s: The Battle of Eupatoria (Russian: Штурм Евпатории, lit. 'Storm of Eupatoria'; Turkish: Gözleve Muharebesi) occurred on 17 February 1855 during the Crimean War when the army of the Russian Empire unsuccessfully attempted to capture the Crimean port city of Eupatoria held by the forces of the Ottoman Empire.

zh.s: 叶夫帕托里亚战役（俄语：Штурм Евпатории，意为“强攻叶夫帕托里亚”；土耳其语：Gözleve Muharebesi）发生于1855年2月17日的克里米亚战争期间。俄罗斯帝国军队试图攻占奥斯曼帝国控制的克里米亚港口城市叶夫帕托里亚，但未能得手。

en.s: The Battle of Coplé was a battle in Venezuela, which occurred on 17 February 1860, during the Federal War between the Federalist forces under General Juan Crisóstomo Falcón, and the troops from Conservative government under command of General León de Febres Cordero, with a victory for the latter.

zh.s: 1860年2月17日，委内瑞拉联邦战争期间，胡安·克里索斯托莫·法尔孔将军率联邦派军队，与莱昂·德·费夫雷斯·科尔德罗将军指挥的保守党政府军在科普莱交战，政府军获胜。

en.s: The Battle of Miechów took place on February 17, 1863, near Miechów in Małopolska, Poland (at the time Congress Poland), during the January Uprising. Polish units under Apolinary Kurowski numbering around 2500 troops attacked the town in an attempt to gain control of the so-called border triangle - an area at the cross roads of the Austrian, Prussian and Russian partitions which would have allowed the insurgents access to supplies and troops from outside the Congress Poland where the uprising proper was taking place. They were hoping to surprise Russian troops. However, Russian garrison (2 companies, 550 men) was stronger than expected by insurgents.

zh.s: 1863年2月17日，一月起义期间，阿波利纳里·库罗夫斯基率约2500名波军，在波兰小波兰地区米胡夫附近进攻城镇，当时该地属于波兰会议王国。波军企图控制奥、普、俄三国瓜分区交会的“边境三角”，以便从起义主要发生地会议王国以外，获得补给和人员。他们希望突袭俄军，但俄军驻防兵力比预想强，有两个连共550人。

en.t: Battle of Staszów fought during Poland’s January Uprising
en.s: On 17 February 1863, Polish insurgents fought Russian troops at Staszów, in present-day Poland, during the January Uprising. The insurgents withdrew the following day.

zh.t: 一月起义期间爆发斯塔舒夫战役
zh.s: 1863年2月17日，一月起义期间，波兰起义军在今波兰斯塔舒夫与俄军交战。起义军于次日撤离。

loc: 美国南卡罗来纳州查尔斯顿

en.s: The Sinking of USS Housatonic on 17 February 1864 during the American Civil War was an important turning point in naval warfare. The Confederate States Navy submarine, H.L. Hunley made her first and only attack on a Union Navy warship when she staged a clandestine night attack on the USS Housatonic in Charleston harbor. The Hunley approached just under the surface, avoiding detection until the last moments, then embedded and remotely detonated a spar torpedo that rapidly sank the 1,240 long tons (1,260 t) sloop-of-war with the loss of five Union sailors.

zh.s: 1864年2月17日，美国内战期间，“豪萨托尼克”号被击沉，成为海战史的重要转折。联盟海军“亨利”号潜艇对查尔斯顿港内的联邦军舰发起隐秘夜袭，这是它首次且唯一一次攻击。潜艇贴近水面下方航行，直至最后一刻才被发现，随后将杆式鱼雷嵌入目标并远程引爆，迅速击沉1240长吨（1260公吨）的单桅战舰“豪萨托尼克”号，造成五名联邦水兵死亡。

en.s: The capture of Columbia occurred February 17–18, 1865, during the Carolinas campaign of the American Civil War. The state capital of Columbia, South Carolina, was captured by Union forces under Major General William T. Sherman. Much of the city was burned, although it is not clear which side caused the fires. After Gen. Sherman's March to the Sea captured Savannah, Georgia, he turned his forces north and marched into the Carolinas.

zh.s: 1865年2月17日至18日，美国内战卡罗来纳战役期间，威廉·T.谢尔曼少将率联邦军攻占南卡罗来纳州首府哥伦比亚。城市大部分地区被烧毁，但尚不清楚哪一方引发大火。此前，谢尔曼在“向海进军”中攻占佐治亚州萨凡纳，随后率军北上，进入南、北卡罗来纳地区。

en.s: The Battle of Fort Buchanan was an Apache attack on the United States Army post of Old Fort Buchanan in southern Arizona Territory, which occurred on February 17, 1865. Though a skirmish, it ended with a significant Apache victory when they forced the small garrison of California Volunteers to retreat to the Santa Rita Mountains. Fort Buchanan was the only American military post conquered during the war against the Chiricahua.

zh.s: 布坎南堡之战是阿帕奇人于1865年2月17日对美国军队在亚利桑那领地南部的旧布坎南堡驻地发动的一次袭击。虽然只是小规模冲突，但阿帕奇人迫使加利福尼亚志愿军的小型守军撤退到圣丽塔山脉，取得了重大胜利。布坎南堡是美国在对抗奇里卡瓦人的战争中唯一被攻陷的军事据点。

en.s: The Battle of Zapote Bridge was fought on February 17, 1897 as part of the Philippine Revolution. Filipino revolutionary forces led by General Emilio Aguinaldo defeated Spanish forces under the command of Governor-General Camilo de Polavieja. In this battle, General Edilberto Evangelista (a Filipino civil engineer, trench builder and member of the Katipunan) was killed.

zh.s: 1897年2月17日，菲律宾革命期间发生萨波特桥战役。埃米利奥·阿奎纳多将军率菲律宾革命军，击败总督卡米洛·德·波拉维耶哈指挥的西班牙军队。菲律宾土木工程师、战壕修筑者兼卡蒂普南成员埃迪尔贝托·埃万赫利斯塔将军在战斗中阵亡。

en.s: The Battle of Rejaf, also known as the Battle of Bedden, was fought on 17 February 1897 between the Belgian-led forces of the Congo Free State and Mahdist rebels in Rejaf (now in present-day South Sudan). The battle resulted in a Congolese victory and the permanent expulsion of the Mahdists from the Lado Enclave, as well as the establishment of a Congolese outpost along the Nile.

zh.s: 雷贾夫之战又称贝登之战，于1897年2月17日爆发。刚果自由邦军队由比利时人率领，在今南苏丹雷贾夫与马赫迪派叛军交战。刚果一方获胜，并永久驱逐马赫迪派势力出拉多飞地，同时在尼罗河沿岸建立刚果前哨。

en.t: Grand Duke Sergei Alexandrovich killed by a bomb in Moscow
en.s: On 17 February 1905, Ivan Kalyayev killed Grand Duke Sergei Alexandrovich with a bomb in the Moscow Kremlin, Russia. The killing took place during the1905 revolution.

en.t: Armory Show opens in New York City
en.s: On February 17, 1913, the International Exhibition of Modern Art, known as the Armory Show, opened at New York City’s69th Regiment Armory in the United States. It introduced a large American audience to recent European and American modern art.

zh.t: 军械库艺术展在纽约开幕
zh.s: 1913年2月17日，国际现代艺术展在美国纽约第69团军械库开幕，后来通称“军械库艺术展”。展览让大批美国观众接触到当时欧美的新兴现代艺术。

en.t: Florence Prag Kahn elected to Congress in California
en.s: On February 17, 1925, Florence Prag Kahn won a special election in California’s fourth congressional district, United States, to fill the term of her late husband Julius Kahn.

zh.t: 弗洛伦斯·普拉格·卡恩在加州国会特别选举中获胜
zh.s: 1925年2月17日，弗洛伦斯·普拉格·卡恩赢得美国加利福尼亚州第四国会选区特别选举，接任已故丈夫朱利叶斯·卡恩的议席。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Portugal on 17 February 1935. Óscar Carmona ran unopposed and was reelected.

zh.s: 葡萄牙于1935年2月17日举行总统选举。奥斯卡·卡尔莫纳在没有对手的情况下再次当选。

en.s: The Battle of Trebeshina (Greek: Μάχη της Τρεμπεσίνας) or the Battle of Mal Trebeshinë was a series of engagements fought between the Greek and Italian armies in southeastern Albania during the Greco-Italian War. The twenty-day battle was fought on the strategic heights that make up the 26-kilometre-long (16 mi) Trebeshinë mountain range, notably Height 1923.

en.s: The 1943 Battle of Voronezh or Voronezh–Kastornoye offensive operation (often credited in Russian as the liberation of Voronezh (освобождение Воронежа)) was a Soviet counter-offensive on the Eastern Front of World War II on recapturing the city of Voronezh during January 1943. It took place between 24 January and 17 February 1943, as 4th phase of the general Soviet winter offensive of 1942–1943, immediately following the Ostrogozhsk–Rossosh offensive.

zh.t: 沃罗涅日—卡斯托尔诺耶攻势
zh.s: 1943年的沃罗涅日战役又称沃罗涅日—卡斯托尔诺耶攻势，是第二次世界大战东线的一场苏军反攻，目标是夺回沃罗涅日。战事于1943年1月24日至2月17日进行，是苏联1942—1943年冬季总攻势的第四阶段，紧接在奥斯特罗戈日斯克—罗索什攻势之后。

en.s: The Battle of Sidi Bou Zid (Unternehmen Frühlingswind/Operation Spring Breeze) took place during the Tunisia Campaign from 14–17 February 1943, in World War II. The battle was fought around Sidi Bou Zid, where a large number of U.S. Army units were mauled by German and Italian forces. It resulted in the Axis forces recapturing the strategically important town of Sbeitla in central Tunisia.

zh.s: 西迪布济德战役（德语行动代号：Frühlingswind，意为“春风行动”）发生于第二次世界大战突尼斯战役期间，时间为1943年2月14日至17日。战斗围绕西迪布济德展开，大批美军部队遭德意联军重创。战役结果是轴心国军队重新夺回突尼斯中部具有战略意义的斯贝伊特拉镇。

en.s: The West Derbyshire by-election of 1944 was held on 17 February 1944. The byelection was held due to the resignation of the incumbent Conservative MP, Henry Hunloke. Hunloke was the brother-in-law of Edward Cavendish, 10th Duke of Devonshire, who had held the seat from 1923 until 1938, when he succeeded to his title and was replaced by Hunloke. The seat had been held previously by Hunloke's father-in-law (1891-1908, before becoming the 9th Duke), and by the 9th Duke's brother-in-law, the future 6th Marquess of Lansdowne (1908-1918). This control by the Cavendish family had been interrupted in 1918-1923 by Charles Frederick White, who was elected as a Liberal.

zh.s: 英国西德比郡选区于1944年2月17日举行补选，原因是保守党现任议员亨利·亨洛克辞职。他与第十代德文郡公爵爱德华·卡文迪许是姻亲；卡文迪许自1923年担任该区议员，1938年继承爵位后由亨洛克接替。更早时，亨洛克的岳父曾于1891年至1908年持有该席，随后继承第九代公爵爵位；第九代公爵的姻亲、后来的第六代兰斯当侯爵，又于1908年至1918年任该区议员。卡文迪许家族的控制仅在1918年至1923年间被自由党当选者查尔斯·弗雷德里克·怀特打断。

zh.s: 1944年2月17日至23日，二战太平洋战役期间，双方在马绍尔群岛埃尼威托克环礁交战。

en.t: US carrier aircraft begin Operation Hailstone against Truk
en.s: On 17 February 1944, US carrier task groups began air attacks on the Japanese naval base at Truk, in present-day Micronesia. The opening fighter sweep began before daybreak as part of Operation Hailstone.

zh.t: 美军舰载机开始空袭特鲁克
zh.s: 1944年2月17日，美军航母编队开始空袭特鲁克的日军海军基地，地点位于今密克罗尼西亚。这是“冰雹行动”的一部分，首轮战斗机出击在天亮前展开。

en.s: General elections were held in Belgium on 17 February 1946. The result was a victory for the Christian Social Party, which won 92 of the 202 seats in the Chamber of Representatives and 51 of the 101 seats in the Senate. Voter turnout was 90.3%. They were the first elections after the Second World War and saw fundamental changes among the political parties. The Flemish National Union, which held 17 seats prior to the war and collaborated with Nazi Germany during the war, was outlawed. The Catholic Party changed into the Christian Social Party while the Belgian Labour Party changed into the Belgian Socialist Party.

zh.s: 比利时于1946年2月17日举行大选，基督教社会党获胜，赢得众议院202席中的92席，以及参议院101席中的51席，投票率为90.3%。这是二战后首次选举，政党格局发生根本变化。战前有17席、战时与纳粹德国合作的弗拉芒民族联盟遭禁；天主教党改组为基督教社会党，比利时工党则改为比利时社会党。

en.s: The al-Waziri coup (Arabic: الثورة الدستورية اليمنية, romanized: al-thawra ad-dustūr al-Yamaniyya, lit. 'Yemeni Constitutional Revolution' ), also known as the Yahya clan coup, was a violent dynasty overthrow attempt in the Kingdom of Yemen in 1948, which caused around 5,000 fatalities. During the coup attempt, Imam Yahya Muhammad Hamid ed-Din, the ruler of the kingdom, was assassinated and the rival Sayyid family, the al-Wazirs, seized power for several weeks.
en.n: The Al-Waziri coup briefly ousts the ruling Hamidaddin dynasty of Yemen; Imam Yahya Muhammad Hamid ed-Din is killed.

zh.s: 瓦齐里政变（阿拉伯语：الثورة الدستورية اليمنية，罗马字：al-thawra ad-dustūr al-Yamaniyya，意为“也门宪政革命”）又称叶海亚家族政变，是1948年也门王国发生的一场暴力政权更迭企图，造成约5,000人死亡。政变期间，统治者伊玛目叶海亚·穆罕默德·哈米德丁遇刺身亡，竞争对手赛义德家族的瓦齐里派夺取政权数周。
zh.n: 瓦齐里政变短暂推翻也门的哈米德丁王朝，伊玛目叶海亚·穆罕默德·哈米德丁遇害。

en.s: The Brooklyn by-election 1951 was a by-election held in the Brooklyn electorate in Wellington during the 29th New Zealand Parliament, on 17 February 1951. The by-election was caused by the death of incumbent MP Peter Fraser, who had been Prime Minister until 30 November 1949, on 17 December 1950. The by-election was won by Arnold Nordmeyer.

zh.s: 新西兰第29届议会任内，惠灵顿布鲁克林选区于1951年2月17日举行补选。现任议员彼得·弗雷泽于1950年12月17日去世；他曾担任总理至1949年11月30日。阿诺德·诺德迈耶赢得补选。

en.s: The Battle of Chuam-ni was fought between 14–17 February 1951, at Chuam-ni, South Korea, as part of the Chinese People's Volunteer Army (PVA) Third Offensive towards Wonju during the Korean War. The battle was for control of the supply line Route 24.

en.s: The siege of Dak Doa was a military event which took place between 11 and 17 February 1954 during the First Indochina War between elements of a French battle group - Groupement Mobile No. 100 and the Việt Minh. After a seven-day siege the Việt Minh overran and wiped out an outlying French position at Đắk Đoa near Kon Tum.

zh.s: 达克多阿围城战发生于1954年2月11日至17日，是第一次印度支那战争期间，法国第100机动群与越盟部队之间的一场军事行动。围城七天后，越盟攻占并摧毁了达克多阿附近的一处法军外围阵地，地点在昆嵩附近。

en.t: Turkish delegation’s aircraft crashes near Gatwick
en.s: On 17 February 1959, a Turkish Airlines charter carrying prime minister Adnan Menderes crashed near Gatwick Airport in the United Kingdom during a foggy landing approach. Fourteen people died; Menderes was among ten survivors.

zh.t: 土耳其代表团乘坐的飞机在盖特威克附近坠毁
zh.s: 1959年2月17日，一架载有土耳其总理阿德南·曼德列斯的土耳其航空包机，在英国盖特威克机场附近大雾中进近时坠毁。14人遇难，曼德列斯等10人生还。

en.t: Project Vanguard: Vanguard 2: The first weather satellite is launched to measure cloud-cover distribution
en.s: Vanguard 2 (or Vanguard 2E before launch) is an Earth-orbiting satellite launched 17 February 1959 at 15:55:02 GMT, aboard a Vanguard SLV-4 rocket as part of the United States Navy's Project Vanguard. The satellite was designed to measure cloud cover distribution over the daylight portion of its orbit, for a period of 19 days, and to provide information on the density of the atmosphere for the lifetime of its orbit (about 300 years).

zh.t: 先锋2号气象卫星发射，用于测量云层分布
zh.s: 先锋2号（发射前称S-56A）是一颗地球轨道卫星，于1959年2月17日15:55:02（格林尼治标准时间）搭乘先锋SLV-4火箭升空，属于美国海军先锋计划。卫星旨在测量其白昼轨道段的云层分布，任务期为19天；它也计划测量卫星轨道寿命期间的大气密度，预计轨道寿命约300年。

en.t: Gabonese military officers overthrew President Léon M'ba, but French forces, honouring a 1960 treaty, forcibly reinstated him two days later
en.s: The 1964 Gabonese coup d'état was staged between 17 and 19 February 1964 by Gabonese military officers who rose against Gabonese President Léon M'ba. Before the coup, Gabon was seen as one of the most politically stable countries in Africa. The coup resulted from M'ba's dissolution of the Gabonese legislature on 21 January 1964. During a takeover with few casualties, 150 coup plotters arrested M'ba and a number of his government officials.

zh.t: 加蓬军官推翻总统莱昂·姆巴；法国军队依照1960年条约两天后武力复位
zh.s: 1964年2月17日至19日，加蓬军官发动政变，反抗总统莱昂·姆巴。政变前，加蓬被视为非洲政局最稳定的国家之一。政变起因是姆巴于1964年1月21日解散加蓬议会。政变过程中，约150名参与者发动接管行动，伤亡很少，并逮捕了姆巴及多名政府官员。

en.s: Wesberry v. Sanders, 376 U.S. 1 (1964), was a landmark U.S. Supreme Court case in which the Court ruled that districts in the United States House of Representatives must be approximately equal in population. Along with Baker v. Carr (1962) and Reynolds v. Sims (1964), it was part of a series of Warren Court cases that applied the principle of "one person, one vote" to U.S. legislative bodies.

zh.s: 韦斯伯里诉桑德斯案（376 U.S. 1，1964年）是美国最高法院的一起里程碑案件。法院裁定，美国众议院各选区的人口应大致相等。该案与1962年的贝克诉卡尔案、1964年的雷诺兹诉西姆斯案一样，属于沃伦法院将“一人一票”原则适用于美国立法机关的一系列判例。

en.s: Aeroflot Flight 065 was a scheduled passenger flight operated by Aeroflot. On 17 February 1966, the Tupolev Tu-114 operated by the airline crashed during take-off from Sheremetyevo International Airport in Moscow, killing 21 of the 47 passengers and 19 crew members on board. This was the only fatal crash involving the Tu-114.

zh.t: 俄罗斯航空065号班机空难
zh.s: 俄罗斯航空065号班机是一趟定期客运航班。1966年2月17日，航空公司使用的图波列夫Tu-114客机在莫斯科谢列梅捷沃国际机场起飞时坠毁，机上47名乘客中有21人遇难，另有19名机组人员遇难。这是Tu-114唯一一起致命空难。

en.s: Operation Double Eagle was a US Marine Corps and Army of the Republic of Vietnam (ARVN) operation that took place in southern Quảng Ngãi Province, lasting from 28 January to 17 February 1966, during the Vietnam War. The operation was mounted in conjunction with Operation Masher in northern Bình Định Province. The operation was inconclusive as the People's Army of Vietnam (PAVN) and the Vietcong (VC) had largely slipped away.

en.s: On February 17, 1974, Robert Kenneth Preston, a private first class in the U.S. Army, took off in a stolen Bell UH-1B Iroquois "Huey" helicopter from Tipton Field, Maryland, and landed it on the South Lawn of the White House in a significant breach of security. zh.s: 1974年2月17日，美国陆军二等兵罗伯特·肯尼斯·普雷斯顿从马里兰州蒂普顿机场偷驾一架贝尔UH-1B“伊洛魁”直升机起飞，随后降落在白宫南草坪，造成严重的安保漏洞。普雷斯顿参军是为了成为直升机飞行员。

en.s: On 17 February 1978, the Provisional IRA's Belfast Brigade left a large incendiary bomb outside the La Mon House hotel and restaurant in Comber, County Down, near Belfast. The attack, commonly known as the La Mon restaurant bombing, has been described as one of the worst atrocities of the Troubles. The bomb, containing a napalm-like substance, was left outside one of the restaurant's windows.

zh.s: 1978年2月17日，爱尔兰共和军临时派贝尔法斯特旅在贝尔法斯特附近唐郡康伯的拉蒙豪斯酒店及餐厅外放置了一枚大型燃烧弹。此案通常称为拉蒙餐厅爆炸案，被认为是北爱尔兰冲突期间最严重的暴行之一。炸弹含有类似凝固汽油弹的物质，放在餐厅一扇窗户外。

zh.t: 1978年英国陆军“瞪羚”直升机被击落
zh.s: 1978年2月17日，一架序列号为XX404的英国陆军“瞪羚”直升机在北爱尔兰阿马郡琼斯伯勒附近被击落。临时爱尔兰共和军南阿马旅一支部队向直升机开火；当时该部队正与当地“绿夹克”团观察哨交战，直升机奉命前来支援地面部队。

en.t: Sino-Vietnamese War begins as Chinese troops enter northern Vietnam
en.s: On 17 February 1979, Chinese troops entered northern Vietnam, beginning the Sino-Vietnamese War. The offensive crossed the border from China and was followed by weeks of fighting before China withdrew its main invasion force in March.

zh.t: 中越战争爆发，中国军队进入越南北部
zh.s: 1979年2月17日，中国军队越过边界进入越南北部，中越战争爆发。随后双方交战数周，中国于3月撤回主要进攻部队。

A coalition named the Meghalaya United Parliamentary Party was formed by the All Party Hill Leaders Conference (AHL), the Hill State People's Democratic Party, the Public Demands Implementation Convention (PDIC) and two independent members. en.s: The Irish general election of 1987 was held on 17 February 1987, four weeks after the dissolution of the Dáil on 20 January. The newly elected 166 members of the 25th Dáil assembled at Leinster House on 10 March when a new Taoiseach and a Fianna Fáil minority government were appointed. The general election took place in 41 parliamentary constituencies throughout Ireland for 166 seats in the lower house of parliament, Dáil Éireann.

en.s: Presidential elections were held for the first time in Cape Verde on 17 February 1991, as previously the National Assembly had elected the President. The result was a victory for António Mascarenhas Monteiro of the Movement for Democracy, which had also won the parliamentary elections the previous month. He defeated incumbent Aristides Pereira of the African Party for the Independence of Cape Verde.

zh.s: 佛得角于1991年2月17日首次举行总统直选，此前总统由国民议会选出。民主运动的安东尼奥·马斯卡雷尼亚斯·蒙泰罗，击败佛得角非洲独立党的现任总统阿里斯蒂德斯·佩雷拉。民主运动也刚在前一个月赢得议会选举。

en.s: Ryan International Airlines Flight 590 was a cargo flight carrying mail for the United States Postal Service from Greater Buffalo International Airport (BUF) in Buffalo, New York, to Indianapolis International Airport (IND) in Indiana, with a stopover at Cleveland Hopkins International Airport (CLE) in Cleveland, Ohio. On February 17, 1991, the McDonnell Douglas DC-9-15RC operating the flight crashed on takeoff from Cleveland during icing conditions.

zh.t: 瑞安国际航空590号班机空难
zh.s: 瑞安国际航空590号班机为美国邮政局运送邮件，从纽约州布法罗大布法罗国际机场飞往印第安纳州印第安纳波利斯国际机场，中途经停俄亥俄州克利夫兰霍普金斯国际机场。1991年2月17日，执行航班的麦道DC-9-15RC在结冰天气下从克利夫兰起飞时坠毁。

en.s: The Capture of Garadaghly (Azerbaijani: Qaradağlının işğalı) was the seizure of Garadaghly, an Azerbaijani-populated village in Khojavend district of Nagorno-Karabakh by Armenian volunteer units on 17 February 1992, in the First Nagorno-Karabakh War.

zh.s: 加拉达格雷村被占领（阿塞拜疆语：Qaradağlının işğalı）发生于1992年2月17日。第一次纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫战争期间，亚美尼亚志愿部队攻占了纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫霍贾文德区内一个以阿塞拜疆人为主的村庄加拉达格雷。

en.s: CyberSlam (1996) was the first CyberSlam professional wrestling event produced by Extreme Championship Wrestling (ECW). The event took place on February 17, 1996 in the ECW Arena in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania in the United States. 10 professional wrestling matches were contested at the event. In the main event, Raven defeated The Sandman to retain the ECW World Heavyweight Championship.

zh.s: 1996年网络摔角大赛是极限冠军摔角（ECW）制作的首场同名职业摔角赛事，于2月17日在美国宾夕法尼亚州费城ECW竞技场举行。当晚进行十场比赛，主赛中雷文击败睡魔，保住ECW世界重量级冠军。

en.s: The 1996 Bloc Québécois leadership election was the leadership election to replace Lucien Bouchard after he left the Bloc Québécois to become Premier of Quebec. Bloc MP Michel Gauthier won the election and became Leader of the Official Opposition. Gauthier's lack of profile resulted in some opposition parties mocking him as being the "faceless leader" of the opposition, as he was largely a political unknown in most of Canada and even in Quebec.

zh.s: 1996年魁人政团举行党魁选举，以接替离党并出任魁北克省长的吕西安·布沙尔。魁人政团国会议员米歇尔·戈蒂耶赢得选举，成为官方反对党领袖。戈蒂耶知名度不高，其他反对党因此嘲笑他是“无面孔的反对党领袖”；他在加拿大大部分地区、甚至魁北克都几乎不为人所知。

en.t: NEAR Shoemaker launches as the first Discovery mission
en.s: On February 17, 1996, NASA launched NEAR Shoemaker from Cape Canaveral, Florida, United States, on a DeltaII rocket. It was the first launch in NASA’s Discovery Program and later orbited and landed on the asteroid Eros.

zh.t: NEAR舒梅克号作为发现计划首个任务发射
zh.s: 1996年2月17日，美国国家航空航天局用德尔塔II火箭，从美国佛罗里达州卡纳维拉尔角发射NEAR舒梅克号。这是“发现计划”首个发射的任务，后来探测器进入爱神星轨道并在其表面着陆。

en.t: Kasparov wins his1996 match against Deep Blue
en.s: On 17 February 1996, Garry Kasparov won the final game of his six-game match against IBM’s Deep Blue in Philadelphia, United States, taking the match 4–2. Deep Blue had won the first game, but its match victory came in 1997.

zh.t: 卡斯帕罗夫赢得1996年对深蓝的比赛
zh.s: 1996年2月17日，加里·卡斯帕罗夫在美国费城赢得与IBM“深蓝”六局比赛的最后一局，以总比分4比2获胜。深蓝虽然赢了首局，但它赢得整场对抗赛是在1997年。

en.s: Operation Valiancy (Filipino: Oplan Kagitingan) was the initial military operation of the 2000 Philippine campaign against the Moro Islamic Liberation Front which took place in Maguindanao (before the province's division), Philippines. The Philippine Army, primarily units of its 6th Infantry Division, assaulted Moro Islamic Liberation Front forces in the Talayan-Shariff Aguak-Datu Piang area of Maguindanao and captured Camp Omar ibn al-Khattab, its third largest camp located there.

zh.s: “英勇”行动（菲律宾语：Oplan Kagitingan）是菲律宾军方在2000年针对摩洛伊斯兰解放阵线发起的军事行动，行动地点位于马京达瑙（该省后来分拆）。菲律宾陆军主要调动第6步兵师部队，进攻塔拉扬—谢里夫阿瓜克—达图皮昂一带的摩洛伊斯兰解放阵线武装，并攻占了该组织在当地第三大的营地奥马尔·伊本·哈塔卜营地。

en.s: The 2001 Queensland state election was held on 17 February 2001 to elect the 89 members of the state's Legislative Assembly. The result of the election was the return of the Labor Party (ALP) government of Premier Peter Beattie, with an increased majority in a landslide. Labor won 66 seats, easily the most it has ever won in Queensland and one of Labor's best-ever results nationwide.

zh.s: 昆士兰州于2001年2月17日举行选举，选出州立法议会89名议员。选举后，州长彼得·比蒂领导的工党（ALP）政府连任，并以压倒性优势扩大多数席位。工党赢得66席，是该党在昆士兰州赢得席位最多的一次，也是工党在全国范围内成绩最好的一次。

en.s: No Way Out (2002) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by World Wrestling Federation (WWF). The event took place on February 17, 2002, at the Bradley Center in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. It is also the last No Way Out event produced under the WWF initials.

zh.s: 2002年无路可逃是世界摔角联盟（WWF）制作的职业摔角按次付费赛事，于2月17日在美国威斯康星州密尔沃基布拉德利中心举行。这也是最后一届以WWF简称制作的无路可逃赛事。

en.s: The 52nd annual Berlin International Film Festival was held from February 6 to 17, 2002. The festival opened with Heaven by Tom Tykwer. The new print of Charlie Chaplin's 1940 American satirical dramedy film The Great Dictator was the closing film of the festival. The Golden Bear was jointly awarded to Bloody Sunday, directed by Paul Greengrass, and Spirited Away, by Hayao Miyazaki.

zh.s: 第52届柏林国际电影节于2002年2月6日至17日举行。电影节以汤姆·提克威执导的《天堂》开幕。查理·卓别林1940年执导的美国讽刺喜剧剧情片《大独裁者》修复版作为闭幕片放映。保罗·格林格拉斯执导的《血腥星期天》和宫崎骏执导的《千与千寻》共同获得金熊奖。

en.s: The 2004 United States House of Representatives special election in Kentucky's 6th congressional district was held on February 17, 2004 to select the successor to Ernie Fletcher (R) who resigned upon being elected Governor of Kentucky. Each party held a nominating convention to choose their nominee for the special election. Republicans selected state Senator Alice Kerr over state Representatives Stan Lee and Lonnie Napier and Lexington city councilman Charles Ellinger II as their nominee while Democrats chose former state Attorney General and 2003 Democratic gubernatorial nominee Ben Chandler. Chandler won the election to fill out the rest of Fletcher's unexpired term.

zh.t: 2004年肯塔基州第六国会选区特别选举
zh.s: 美国肯塔基州第六国会选区于2004年2月17日举行联邦众议员特别选举，接替当选州长后辞职的共和党人厄尼·弗莱彻。两党各自召开提名大会。共和党选出州参议员艾丽斯·克尔，击败州众议员斯坦·李、朗尼·纳皮尔及列克星敦市议员查尔斯·埃林格二世；民主党则提名前州司法部长、2003年民主党州长候选人本·钱德勒。钱德勒赢得选举，接续弗莱彻尚未届满的任期。

en.s: The 2004 Wisconsin Democratic presidential primary took place on February 17, 2004 as part of the 2004 Democratic Party presidential primaries. The delegate allocation is Proportional. The candidates are awarded delegates in proportion to the percentage of votes received and is open to registered Democrats only. A total of 72 (of 87) delegates are awarded proportionally. A 15 percent threshold is required to receive delegates.

zh.t: 2004年威斯康星州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 威斯康星州于2004年2月17日举行民主党总统初选，是当年民主党总统提名竞选的一部分，仅限登记为民主党人的选民参加。全州87个代表名额中的72个按候选人得票比例分配，候选人须达到15%的门槛才有资格分得名额。

en.s: The 2004 Wisconsin Republican presidential primary was held on February 17, 2004, as part of the 2004 Republican Party primaries for the 2004 presidential election. 37 delegates to the 2004 Republican National Convention were allocated to presidential candidates. President George W. Bush won easily by receiving all the delegate votes because most of his opponents were not on the ballot, except for his only opponent in the state of Wisconsin, Uncommitted.

zh.t: 2004年威斯康星州共和党总统初选
zh.s: 威斯康星州于2004年2月17日举行共和党总统初选，分配37个共和党全国代表大会代表名额，是当年总统提名竞选的一部分。现任总统乔治·W.布什轻松获胜，得到全部代表票。因为大多数对手未列入选票，他在该州唯一的对手是“不承诺支持任何候选人”选项。

en.s: The Cypriot presidential election of 2008 was held on 17 February 2008, with the runoff held on 24 February 2008. The second-round winner, and thus the President of Cyprus for the next term, was Dimitris Christofias. The first round, held on February 17, saw a close result between three leading candidates, Dimitris Christofias of AKEL, Ioannis Kasoulidis of Democratic Rally, and the incumbent Tassos Papadopoulos. Results showed Kasoulidis in first place with about 33.51%, Christofias in second with 33.29%, and Papadopoulos in third with 31.79%. Christophias and Kasoulidis therefore participated in a second round on February 24.

zh.s: 塞浦路斯于2008年2月17日举行总统选举，第二轮投票于2月24日举行，季米特里斯·赫里斯托菲亚斯最终获胜，成为下一任总统。首轮三名主要候选人得票接近：民主大会党的扬尼斯·卡苏利季斯约33.51%，劳动人民进步党的赫里斯托菲亚斯33.29%，现任总统塔索斯·帕帕佐普洛斯31.79%。因此，赫里斯托菲亚斯与卡苏利季斯进入第二轮。

en.s: The 2008 No Way Out was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE). It was the 10th No Way Out and took place on February 17, 2008, at the Thomas & Mack Center in Paradise, Nevada in the Las Vegas area, held for wrestlers from the promotion's Raw, SmackDown, and ECW brand divisions.

zh.s: 2008年无路可逃是世界摔角娱乐公司（WWE）举办的职业摔角按次付费赛事。这是第十届无路可逃，于2008年2月17日在美国内华达州拉斯维加斯地区帕拉代斯的托马斯与马克中心举行，由Raw、SmackDown及ECW品牌选手参赛。

en.t: Kosovo representatives adopt a declaration of independence
en.s: On 17 February 2008, Kosovo representatives meeting in Pristina adopted a declaration of independence from Serbia. Serbia rejected the declaration, and Kosovo’s statehood remains internationally disputed.

zh.s: 2008年2月17日，科索沃代表在普里什蒂纳开会，通过脱离塞尔维亚的独立宣言。塞尔维亚反对这一声明，科索沃的国家地位在国际上仍有争议。

en.s: Kyoto held a mayoral election on February 17, 2008. Daisaku Kadokawa narrowly won over a candidate backed by the JCP with a margin of 951 votes.

zh.s: 京都于2008年2月17日举行市长选举。角川大作以951票的微弱优势击败了得到日本共产党支持的候选人。

en.s: La Jaula del Honor (Spanish for "The Cage of Honor") was a major professional wrestling event produced by the International Wrestling Revolution Group (IWRG), that took place on February 17, 2011, at Arena Naucalpan in Naucalpan, State of Mexico. The title of the event, La Jaula del Honor, referred to the main event match, a steel cage match that involved three, three-man teams contested under elimination rules. A wrestler would "escape" the match by climbing up the side of the cage and out, with the last remaining wrestler in the cage, along with his team mates. being deemed the loser of the match.

zh.s: 荣誉之笼是国际摔角革命集团（IWRG）于2011年2月17日在墨西哥州瑙卡尔潘竞技场举办的大型职业摔角赛事。名称来自主赛：三支三人队参加淘汰制钢笼赛。选手爬过笼壁逃出，即可退出比赛；最后留在笼内的选手及其队友，被判为败方。

en.s: General elections were held in Ecuador on 17 February 2013 to elect the President, the National Assembly, Provincial Assemblies and members of the Andean Parliament. The incumbent President Rafael Correa was re-elected by a wide margin. Correa's closest electoral rival, Guillermo Lasso, conceded the election shortly after it concluded. The vote had been set for January 2013, but was put back a month to allow a full year to elapse after the reform of election rules. This was the first election since 1996 held after the natural expiration of a four-year presidential term.

zh.s: 厄瓜多尔于2013年2月17日举行大选，选出总统、国民议会、省议会及安第斯议会议员。现任总统拉斐尔·科雷亚以明显优势连任，最接近的对手吉列尔莫·拉索在投票结束后不久承认败选。选举原定于1月举行，为让选举规则改革后满一年而延后一个月。这是自1996年以来，首次在总统四年任期正常届满后举行的选举。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Cyprus on 17 February 2013. A runoff was held on 24 February 2013. Nicos Anastasiades of Democratic Rally won the election. The other candidates were Stavros Malas of the Progressive Party of Working People (AKEL); Praxoula Antoniadou of the United Democrats; Lakis Ioannou with the support of LASOK; Loukas Stavrou; ELAM's Giorgos Charalambous, Giorgos Lillikas of Movement for Social Democracy (EDEK); and independents Andreas Efstratiou, Makaria-Andri Stylianou, Kostas Kyriacou(Outopos) and Solon Gregoriou. Although the president Demetris Christofias was not term-limited, he did not seek re-election in 2013.

zh.s: 塞浦路斯于2013年2月17日举行总统选举，第二轮于2月24日举行，民主大会党的尼科斯·阿纳斯塔夏季斯获胜。其他候选人包括劳动人民进步党的斯塔夫罗斯·马拉斯、联合民主党的普拉克苏拉·安东尼亚杜、得到LASOK支持的拉基斯·约安努、卢卡斯·斯塔夫鲁、民族人民阵线的乔治斯·哈拉兰布斯、社会民主运动的乔治斯·利利卡斯，以及独立候选人安德烈亚斯·埃夫斯特拉蒂乌、马卡里娅-安德里·斯蒂利亚努、科斯塔斯·基里亚库（乌托波斯）和索隆·格里戈里乌。现任总统季米特里斯·赫里斯托菲亚斯虽未受任期限制，但没有寻求连任。

en.s: The 63rd annual Berlin International Film Festival took place in Berlin, Germany between 7 and 17 February 2013. Chinese film director Wong Kar-wai was announced as the President of the Jury and his film The Grandmaster was the opening film of the festival. The Golden Bear was awarded to the Romanian film Child's Pose directed by Călin Peter Netzer, which also served as the closing film. The French documentary filmmaker Claude Lanzmann was awarded with the Honorary Golden Bear. Italian actress Isabella Rossellini and German film director Rosa von Praunheim were awarded with the Berlinale Camera.

zh.s: 第63届柏林国际电影节于2013年2月7日至17日在德国柏林举行。中国导演王家卫担任评审团主席，其电影《一代宗师》作为开幕片。卡林·彼得·内策尔执导的罗马尼亚电影《孩童姿势》获得金熊奖，同时也是闭幕片。法国纪录片导演克洛德·朗兹曼获荣誉金熊奖，意大利演员伊莎贝拉·罗西里尼和德国导演罗萨·冯·普劳恩海姆获柏林电影节摄影机奖。

en.s: Elimination Chamber (2013) (also known as No Escape (2013) in Germany) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by WWE. It took place on February 17, 2013, at the New Orleans Arena in New Orleans, Louisiana. The pay-per-view was the fourth annual Elimination Chamber event. This year's event was headlined by The Rock defending the WWE Championship against CM Punk.

zh.s: 2013年铁笼密室淘汰赛是WWE制作的职业摔角按次付费赛事，在德国称为“无处可逃”。这是第四届年度同名赛事，于2013年2月17日在美国路易斯安那州新奥尔良竞技场举行。主赛由巨石强森对阵CM Punk，保卫WWE冠军。

en.s: The 2016 Uzbekistan Super Cup (Uzbek: Futbol boʻyicha 2016-yilgi Oʻzbekiston Superkubogi) was the fourth edition of the Uzbekistan Super Cup. The match took place on 17 February at the Bunyodkor Stadium in Tashkent, between the 2015 Uzbek League champions — Pakhtakor and the 2015 Uzbekistan Cup winners — Nasaf. Nasaf won the match and claimed the Uzbekistan Super Cup title for the first time in their history.

zh.s: 2016年乌兹别克斯坦超级杯（乌兹别克语：Futbol boʻyicha 2016-yilgi Oʻzbekiston Superkubogi）是第四届乌兹别克斯坦超级杯。比赛于2月17日在塔什干的布尼奥德科尔体育场举行，由2015年乌兹别克斯坦联赛冠军帕克塔科尔队对阵2015年乌兹别克斯坦杯冠军纳萨夫队。纳萨夫获胜，队史首次夺得乌兹别克斯坦超级杯冠军。

en.s: The Stanytsia Luhanska kindergarten bombing was an event directly preceding the 2022 Russian Invasion of Ukraine. en.s: The 2024 Japanese Super Cup (known as Fujifilm Super Cup 2024 for sponsorship reasons) was the 31st Japanese Super Cup since its reestablishment, and the 39th overall.
